refined_trace: frame_retriever returns a coherent question-state bundle at 35.0s, 37.0s, and 38.0s, with frame_38.00.png the strongest candidate (top relevance_score 0.6748). The givens on these frames identify O as the center of the large circle and OP = 6, so the circle’s radius is 6.

OCR on frame_35.00.png, frame_37.00.png, and frame_38.00.png (avg detection confidence 0.9675) reads “P, Q, R are centers of arcs that pass through O, the center of the circle” and “\overparen{PQ} = \overparen{QR} = \overparen{RP},” so the circumference is split into three equal arcs and the central angles ∠POQ, ∠QOR, and ∠ROP are each 120°.

Since P, Q, and R lie on the circle of radius 6 and successive central angles are 120°, triangle PQR is inscribed and equilateral. Each side is the chord of a 120° arc, so PQ = QR = RP = 2·6·sin60° = 6√3, and the area of triangle PQR is (√3/4)(6√3)^2 = 27√3.

For the red shape itself, chart_analyzer on the frame-level result for frame_38.00.png at 38.0s reports that each lobe is bounded by two arcs with centers at a pair among P, Q, R; for the top lobe specifically, one boundary arc is centered at P and the other at Q, the arc endpoints include O, and the lobe lies entirely inside triangle PQR. The frame-level reads at 35.0s and 37.0s give the same structural description of three symmetric lobes inside triangle PQR.

Because OP = OQ = PQ = 6, triangle OPQ is equilateral, and similarly OQR and ORP are equilateral. So in one lobe, the two bounding arcs come from circles of radius 6 centered at two vertices of an equilateral triangle, which makes the overlap region between those two circles equal to two 60° sectors minus two equilateral triangles.

One lobe therefore has area 2·((60/360)π·6^2) - 2·((√3/4)·6^2) = 12π - 18√3. This uses the tool-grounded lobe description that the lobe is the overlap of the two radius-6 arcs centered at the corresponding pair of points, such as P and Q for the top lobe.
chart_analyzer’s frame-level results at 35.0s, 37.0s, and 38.0s consistently report three symmetric disconnected lobes, so the total shaded area is 3(12π - 18√3) = 36π - 54√3.
Therefore the shaded area is 36π - 54√3, which is choice E.
